build: Birzzle Fever iOS 1.0.4 with ASLR-relative request, failure, and NSError.code hooks
operator_observation: The loading animation appeared for a few seconds, followed by: Failed to connect to network. Please check network status.

game_process_observations.relative_log_order: The newly instrumented NSError.code line precedes Failed:1 in the same game process and syslog second.

capture_limit: The supervised capture exited without running its crash-copy or finalization steps. The raw game-process syslog and a privacy-filtered four-line excerpt exist, but this session does not establish whether a crash report was available.
interpretation: RankingCore connection:didFailWithError: received an NSError with numeric code 8 before ConnectorProxy reported failure for request ID 1. The NSError domain, underlying URL and required server response state are unknown. Numeric code 8 alone cannot distinguish network error classes or justify manufacturing an offline success response.
next_action: Determine the NSError domain and the request ID 1 endpoint/response contract before choosing a local offline implementation. Do not repeat the same network-alert launch merely to confirm this result; gate any new iPad diagnostic on separate operator readiness.
privacy: No token, member identifier, device identifier, endpoint, request body, account field or raw crash filename is included. Raw iPad syslog and app archives remain private in ignored ios/captures. Android was not used.
